title: Leon Kilat Half Marathon 2026 Review: Negros Oriental's Mall 21K
seo_title: Leon Kilat Half Marathon 2026 Review | Bacong Philippines
meta_description: Leon Kilat Half Marathon 2026: August 23 at Leon Kilat Mall, Bacong, Negros Oriental. SMOKE10's Negros road race.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 at Leon Kilat Mall in Bacong, Negros Oriental, this SMOKE10 Events half marathon brings road racing to the Negros Island region.
verdict: The Leon Kilat Half Marathon is a SMOKE10 Events production in Bacong, Negros Oriental — a province on Negros Island known for its sugar heritage, Dumaguete's university-town atmosphere, and Apo Island's marine sanctuary. Named after a local Cebuano revolutionary hero, the race carries distinctive Negros character. Leon Kilat Mall provides a practical race hub. August in Negros is the wet season. A regional Philippine half marathon with unique local branding.

sections.heading: Bacong: Negros Oriental
paragraphs: Bacong is a municipality in Negros Oriental, near Dumaguete — the province's university-town capital. [1] The race is named after Leon Kilat, a Cebuano revolutionary hero. SMOKE10 Events brings Clark-based race production experience to Negros.
